```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

set.seed(1470)
statcast_data <- statcast |> 
  filter(pitch_name == "4-Seam Fastball", year %in% c(2021, 2022, 2023)) |> 
  select(pitcher, pitch_name, year, release_speed, pfx_x, pfx_z, release_spin_rate, release_extension, description) |> 
  sample_n(4)

statcast_data

write.csv(statcast_data, "statcast_condensed.csv")


| > 
  select(pitcher, pitch_name, year, release_speed, pfx_x, pfx_z, release_spin_rate, release_extension, description) |>
  rename(velocity = release_speed, horizontal_break = pfx_x, vertical_break = pfx_z, spin = release_spin_rate, extension = release_extension) |> 
  rename_with(~ gsub("_", " ", .)) 


statcast_condensed
```
